Privacy Policy and General Terms and Conditions

Please read the Privacy Policy and General Terms and Conditions governing the International Organization for Migration Vaccine App (“the application”). By clicking “I Agree” below, you are entering into a legally binding agreement with the International Organization for Migration (IOM)

1. PRIVACY POLICY

IOM seeks to ensure that any personal information processed through the application is handled with the utmost care and confidentiality. Data privacy is a human right and is essential to human dignity.

This Privacy Policy, as integral part of the General Terms and Conditions, explains how IOM collects, registers, stores, uses, shares or otherwise processes your information on this application. By accessing and using this application, you agree to the terms in this Privacy Policy.

IMPORTANT NOTICE: You must be over 18 to use the application. If you are under 18, your parents or legal guardians must be the ones to access and accompany you through the site specifically provided in the application.

Who are we?

IOM is a United Nations related organization working on migration issues. IOM works to help ensure the orderly and human management of migration for the benefit of all. It does so by providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

Why are we collecting personal data about you?

IOM processes your personal data to register your profile in the application. By doing so, you agree that IOM creates your personal digital health space that allows you to access your health information, consult appointments and carry out procedures in a simple, secure and confidential way.

What personal data are we collecting?

When you register your profile, you agree that the following mandatory fields with your personal data are recorded in the application: email address, phone number, last name, first name, middle name, date of birth, relationship, and country of location.

You will have an opportunity to confirm your personal data until you enroll your device in the application. Thus, you certify that any information you provide through the application, is true, accurate and up to date.

You agree to maintain the security of your profile and not sharing the details to any third party.

Which data contains your profile?

Upon your confirmation, the relevant data related to your health status and/or of your dependents processed by IOM through the Health Assessments processes will be uploaded and accessible in the application.

For what purpose was your data collected?

The purpose of this application is to provide IOM beneficiaries with a platform to access their health information, consult appointments and carry out procedures in a simple, secure and confidential way.

Your personal data was collected and stored in the IOM’s database for the purpose of providing you with vaccination information, notifications, certificates, health education by one of IOM’s Migration Health Assessment Centers.

Data of your accesses and use of the application would be de-identified by removing your personal information if they need to be used for research such as analysis of migration health issues to inform policy or programme evaluation to improve the service.

IOM will not sell or rent personal data collected through the application.

What security measures are taken to safeguard your information

Any personal data collected, received, used, transferred, stored or otherwise processed by IOM are protected by strict conditions of confidentiality and security, in line with the IOM Data Protection Principles:https://publications.iom.int/system/
files/pdf/iomdataprotection_web.pdf

Who has access to these data?

Except for the purposes for which you accepted to provide your personal data, IOM will not disclose your information or your account in the application to any third party, without your prior informed consent. You can read more about our data sharing policy by viewing the IOM Data Protection Principles, available here

Access to your personal data will be limited to IOM staff members dedicated to managing the application. All IOM staff members must adhere to the IOM Data Protection Principles and are strictly bound by confidentiality obligations.

Your data will be treated as confidential information.

What are your rights and how can you manage your data?

You have the right and responsibility to update all personal data you have supplied to the application. You may change your personal data at any time. For that you will need to contact IOM Medical staff and inform about any change in personal data.

You can access your personal data in the application at any time by logging in and checking your profile. You can also view your notifications history and vaccination documentation.

How long will we keep your data for?

Your data will be retained in accordance with IOM data retention policy, which is currently no fewer than 7 years following collection.

What laws and regulations govern the processing of your data?

All your data is processed in accordance with the IOM Data Protection Principles. IOM reserves the right to change this Privacy Policy at any time. Whenever changes are made, you will be notified through the application and will need to agree in order to continue using it.

Who to contact if you have questions or complaints?

For any questions in relation to your personal data gathered through the application, you may contact: vaccineapp@iom.int
